notes: HUMAN-TRANSCRIBED (2105078). Full-page transcription: every visible line was typed, including printed/boilerplate material, because ocr_f1 scores the whole page -- gold text omitting lines the model correctly reads would count them as false positives and understate precision. '[?]' marks a span that is visible but not confidently legible; nothing was guessed. deed_serial is EMPTY BECAUSE ABSENT: no registry serial was legible on the page. The registration rubber stamp recorded in printed_draft ends 'No. [?]', and that number was not resolved by the transcriber. land_amount is EMPTY BECAUSE ABSENT from this page: the body repeatedly defers to 'নিম্ন তফসিলের লিখিত' (as written in the schedule below), and that schedule is not on this page image. deed_date '15.1.19' is transcribed as-written; the intended era/format is ambiguous and it is the only date on the page. party_names holds the two explicitly labelled roles, দলিল গ্রহিতা (জাহাবকক পাটারি) and দলিল দাত্রী (শ্রীমতী আতরজান), matching the dolil_13 convention; honorifics ('মহা মহিম শ্রীযুক্ত'), patronymics and any scribe are excluded. The printed English/Bangla elements now live in 'text' as human-verified content. printed_draft is RETAINED BUT SUPERSEDED for provenance -- it is model-read and NOT gold. DISCREPANCY TO CHECK: printed_draft also lists 'I R. 8 As.', 'এক রুপয়া আট আনা', an 'INDIA' side panel and a partly-legible 1922 registration stamp, none of which the transcriber typed. Those model-read strings were deliberately NOT merged into gold; confirm against the page whether they are present and should be added by a human.
